description.p: PupilEXT is a free, open-source, cross-platform software to conduct pupillometry research. It can access image streams from various camera devices, and perform pupil tracking on the images either live or offline. Importantly, the software has a streaming feature to allow for human-computer interface research. PupilEXT relies on Qt, and is intended for non-profit research and educational use.
